tabs.title: Friends and Plans
tabs.description: Understand what the friends want to do.

tabs.title: A Good Meeting Place
tabs.description: Think about time, travel and weather.

questions.q: Why does Leo invite his friends to Riverside Park?
choices: He needs help with his maths.
He wants to enjoy a picnic on a sunny day.
He is moving to another country.
He wants to buy a new bicycle.
questions.explanation: Leo suggests a Saturday picnic because the weather should be sunny.

questions.q: What does Ana say about Leo's little brother?
choices: She wants him to stay at home.
She thinks he should bring the drinks.
She asks him to meet them on Sunday.
She is happy for him to join them.
questions.explanation: Ana says Max is very welcome.

questions.q: Why does Sam need the friends to choose an exact place?
choices: The park is large and they might not find one another.
He does not know what a café is.
His bus does not stop near the park.
He wants to change the date of the picnic.
questions.explanation: Sam explains that Riverside Park is very big.

questions.q: Why does the group meet after Ana's piano lesson?
choices: The park opens only in the evening.
The bus cannot travel before lunch.
She is not free earlier in the morning.
The café sells food only on Sundays.
questions.explanation: Ana's lesson ends at eleven and she proposes meeting later.

questions.q: Why is a café with a green door a useful place to meet?
choices: It is the only place with a piano.
It is easy for everyone to recognise.
It is where Leo's brother lives.
It has the cheapest bus tickets.
questions.explanation: Sam suggests the café because the landmark is easy to find.

questions.q: Why does Leo ask people to arrive on time?
choices: The park closes at twelve.
The picnic will be on Friday.
He needs to catch a train at one.
His mother can stay with them only until three.
questions.explanation: Leo explains the time limit for his mother's stay.

questions.q: A friend asks, 'Will it be cold?' What is a helpful answer?
choices: Bring a jacket because the park can be windy.
There is no wind near water.
You should bring a school uniform.
The meeting is inside a warm classroom.
questions.explanation: Leo recommends a jacket for the windy area near the water.

questions.q: Sam wants to play music. How does he plan to be kind to others?
choices: He will make every friend sing.
He will play music until midnight.
He will keep the volume low.
He will ask everyone to bring headphones.
questions.explanation: Sam says he will not play his speaker too loudly.

questions.q: What can Ana bring to make sitting in the park easier?
choices: A bicycle repair kit.
A school football trophy.
A pair of train tickets.
A big blanket for the picnic.
questions.explanation: Ana offers a blanket for the picnic.

questions.q: Which message would make the picnic arrangements clear?
choices: I will come to a different park tomorrow.
See you at twelve by the café near the lake!
I may be late but will not tell you.
Let's meet whenever we feel ready.
questions.explanation: The group's final agreed location and time are given clearly.
